content.short: Remox is a simplified and collaborative treasury management tool designed for DAOs.
content.description: Remox is a simplified, collaborative treasury management tool for DAOs. It helps teams manage multi-wallets, run payroll, onboard contributors, and handle budgeting and reporting, while keeping books and accounting in order. It also enables DeFi investments with dynamic risk assessments to mitigate exposure. By surfacing insights into the organization’s finances, Remox empowers community members to participate in proposals and governance with transparent, data-driven decision making.
content.meta: Remox is a simplified treasury tool for wallets, payroll, DeFi investments with risk assessments. Discover Remox and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
